::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 26th [1874]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Ewelme Cottage, 11 Ayr St., Parnell, Auckland, N.Z. [footnote:1]]
:::

Dear [Madam](people/person_1839.qmd)
'On Nebo’s lonely Mountain' is by [Mrs Alexander](people/person_21.qmd), wife of the [Bishop of Derry](people/person_1840.qmd), and author of [Hymns for Little Children](other_books/otherbook_11.qmd) – It is one of a series of hymns on Scripture which were published separately.

I have often met with mentions of [Mr Lush](people/person_1838.qmd) and his family in [Bishop Patteson](people/person_1155.qmd)’s letters and always with great affection[^2]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^2]: Miss Lush’s brother the Rev. Vicesimus Lush (1817-1882) had emigrated to New Zealand in 1850 and worked in various capacities in the Auckland region under Bishop Selwyn. See his *The Auckland Journals, 1850-63* and *The Thames Journals 1868-82*.

**Note:** With envelope addressed to Miss Lush/ Northlands/ Hollington/ S. Leonards-on-Sea, and postmarked Winchester 26 March 1874.
